hypothesizes that the discharge of a river is constant over time. However, the discharge of a river is never truly constant (i.e., never steady) and varies slightly from second to second, even in controlled rivers. To model the inherently unsteady flows of rivers, we can discretize time-dependent discharge (e.g., a flood hydrograph) in a numerical model as a series of steady discharges.

), which is neither compatible with parallelization routines, nor with the here used
